12. (a) Consider the following recursive function:
refn(N)
if N < 1
then
return 1
else
if N mod 2 = 0
then
return refn(N-1) - N
else
return refn(N-1) + N
endif
endif
end refn
Determine the value of variable after execution of the following program statement:
X
X = refn(5)
Show all your working. [5]
